text_en: The oracle concerning Babylon that Isaiah son of Amoz saw.
text_cn: 阿摩兹的儿子依撒意亚所见有关巴比伦的神谕：

text_en: On a bare hill raise a signal, cry aloud to them; wave the hand for them to enter the gates of the nobles.
text_cn: 你们在秃山上竖起旗帜，向他们高呼挥手，叫他们走进王侯的御门！

text_en: I myself have commanded my consecrated ones, have summoned my warriors, my proudly exulting ones, to execute my anger.
text_cn: 我已向我圣洁的人下令，并为了我的愤怒，召集了我的战士，我那骄矜自喜的常胜军。

text_en: Listen, a tumult on the mountains as of a great multitude! Listen, an uproar of kingdoms, of nations gathering together! The Lord of hosts is mustering an army for battle.
text_cn: 听！山上有喧嚣声，好像有无数的人群。听！列国的嘈杂声，万民正在聚集；万军的上主正在检阅赴敌的部队：

text_en: They come from a distant land, from the end of the heavens, the Lord and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole earth.
text_cn: 他们都来自远方，来自天边。上主和他盛怒的工具，要来毁灭整个大地。

text_en: Wail, for the day of the Lord is near; it will come like destruction from the Almighty!
text_cn: 号啕吧！因为上主的日子近了，它来有如全能者实行毁灭；

text_en: Therefore all hands will be feeble, and every human heart will melt,
text_cn: 为此，人手将要松懈，人心将要消融，

text_en: and they will be dismayed. Pangs and agony will seize them; they will be in anguish like a woman in labor. They will look aghast at one another; their faces will be aflame.
text_cn: 人人都惊慌失措，剧疼和痛苦侵袭他们，痉挛得有如临产的妇女；他们彼此惊愕相视，面容有如火焰。

text_en: See, the day of the Lord comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger, to make the earth a desolation, and to destroy its sinners from it.
text_cn: 看哪！上主的日子来到，必有残忍、雷霆和烈怒，为使大地变为荒凉，为歼灭地上的罪人。

text_en: For the stars of the heavens and their constellations will not give their light; the sun will be dark at its rising, and the moon will not shed its light.
text_cn: 那时，天上的众星与群宿不再发光，太阳一升起即变为昏黑，月亮也不再放光明。

text_en: I will punish the world for its evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; I will put an end to the pride of the arrogant, and lay low the insolence of tyrants.
text_cn: 我要惩罚世界，是为了它的罪恶；惩罚恶人，是为了他们的恶行；要抑制自负者的骄横，要屈服暴虐者的傲慢；

text_en: I will make mortals more rare than fine gold, and humans than the gold of Ophir.
text_cn: 我要使人比提炼的黄金更少见，使人比敖非尔纯金更希罕。

text_en: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken out of its place, at the wrath of the Lord of hosts in the day of his fierce anger.
text_cn: 为此，由于万军上主的愤怒，在他暴发怒火之日，天要震撼，地要震动，离其本位。

text_en: Like a hunted gazelle, or like sheep with no one to gather them, all will turn to their own people, and all will flee to their own lands.
text_cn: 那时，人们将如被追逐的羚羊，又如无人率领的羊群，各自转向自己的民族，各自逃回自己的故乡。

text_en: Whoever is found will be thrust through, and whoever is caught will fall by the sword.
text_cn: 凡被捕获的，都要被刺杀；凡被擒住的，都要丧身刀下。

text_en: Their infants will be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses will be plundered, and their wives ravished.
text_cn: 他们的婴儿将在他们眼前被人摔死，他们的房屋将被洗劫，他们的妇女要受奸污。

text_en: See, I am stirring up the Medes against them, who have no regard for silver and do not delight in gold.
text_cn: 我要鼓励玛待人来攻击他们，这些人既不重视白银，也不贪爱黄金。

text_en: Their bows will slaughter the young men; they will have no mercy on the fruit of the womb; their eyes will not pity children.
text_cn: 他们的弓箭要刺死青年，对腹中的胎儿毫不怜恤，对于婴儿，他们的眼睛也毫不怜视。

text_en: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the splendor and pride of the Chaldeans, will be like Sodom and Gomorrah when God overthrew them.
text_cn: 巴比伦──万国的光辉，加色丁的骄矜荣耀，必要被上主倾覆，如同索多玛和哈摩辣一样，

text_en: It will never be inhabited or lived in for all generations; Arabs will not pitch their tents there, shepherds will not make their flocks lie down there.
text_cn: 永远再没有居民，世世代代无人居住；阿剌伯人不在那里设帐，牧人也不在那里立栏；

text_en: But wild animals will lie down there, and its houses will be full of howling creatures; there ostriches will live, and there goat-demons will dance.
text_cn: 卧在那里的只有野兽，他们的房屋满了鸱（chī）鸮（xiāo）；鸵鸟在那里栖息，魍（wǎng）魉（liǎng）在那里舞蹈；

text_en: Hyenas will cry in its towers, and jackals in the pleasant palaces; its time is close at hand, and its days will not be prolonged.
text_cn: 豺狼在宫殿里嗥（háo）叫，野狗在御苑内呼应；她的时期已来近了，她的日子不会久延。
